name: v2.2.30
body:
Published to npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ccstatusline

## What's Changed
* chore(deps-dev): bump typescript from 6.0.3 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/578
* chore(deps-dev): bump chalk from 5.6.2 to 6.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/579
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-dependencies group across 1 directory with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/589
* Add claudenews to Related Projects by @bhpark1013 in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/584
* fix: add timeout to the cached git runner by @tahodev in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/585
* fix(git): time out cached commands by @SR0725 in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/559
* feat(usage): let the reset timers hide their no-data placeholders by @zachthedev in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/542
* refactor(usage): extract the usage-percent widgets onto a shared module by @zachthedev in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/545
* feat(custom-command): cache output behind an opt-in TTL and honor the timeout by @zachthedev in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/539
* fix(usage): parse a model-scoped weekly limit at 0% with no resets_at as real zero usage by @emotionalboySY in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/534
* feat(widgets): give the remaining git and jj widgets symbol slots by @zachthedev in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/574
* Add llms.txt for LLM/agent-readable project summary by @abyworkings-coder in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/527
* fix(usage): read the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR keychain credential first on macOS by @nguerrier in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/573
* fix(usage): fingerprint the usage cache by refresh token so a routine token refresh is not read as an account switch by @emotionalboySY in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/536
* fix: default flex mode to full by @godlockin in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/349

## New Contributors
* @bhpark1013 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/584

* @abyworkings-coder made their first contribution in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/527
* @nguerrier made their first contribution in https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline/pull/573
